# Hey Town Hall Data Provider

Manages a Hey Town Hall Data organisation: API keys, team members and invitations, the monthly spending cap, the organisation's name, and single sign-on connections.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    heytownhall = {
      source  = "ailio-technologies-inc/heytownhall"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# The token comes from the HEYTOWNHALL_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN environment variable.
# Create one in the dashboard (an organisation owner can). It starts with htd_mgmt_.
provider "heytownhall" {}

# Or pass it from a sensitive variable.
variable "heytownhall_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

provider "heytownhall" {
  alias = "explicit"
  token = var.heytownhall_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) The API's base URL. Defaults to `https://data.heytownhall.com`. Can also be set with the `HEYTOWNHALL_ENDPOINT` environment variable. Only needed for testing against another deployment.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) A management token (it starts with `htd_mgmt_`). An organisation owner creates it in the dashboard. Can also be set with the `HEYTOWNHALL_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN` environment variable. A data API key (`htd_test_` or `htd_live_`) does not work here.
